messages:
anya: Quick sync: short checklist for the console/analytics schema migration. Primary constraints: no dashboard breakages, safe rollback, low index churn.
rohan: high level plan?
anya: dual-write -> shadow projection -> staged canary. Need concrete gates for quota routing metrics and dashboards.
mike: For dual-write, stamp `ingest_version` on each envelope (e.g. v2-2024-05) and also write a compact `ingest_projection` row to avoid JSON bloat on reads.
jess: UI: subtle badge when results are from shadow data; feature-flagged toggle to switch read mode. Also add support notification at 20% canary.
eva: Telemetry: emit mismatch_ratio and `ingest_migration_toggle`. Start deterministic sampling at 1% but always include low-cardinality routes.
rohan: Canary suggestion: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h. Abort if mismatch_ratio > 0.02 for routes >1000/day or if p95 increases >25%.
mike: To protect query perf, projection table should have index on (route_id, day) and a TTL to drop old rows. I'll prototype DDL.
anya: Rollback runbook must include exact commands: SQL toggle and admin API example.
rohan: Example SQL in runbook: `UPDATE feature_flags SET value='v1-only' WHERE key='console.ingest.read_mode';` and admin endpoint `POST /admin/feature-toggle?mode=v1-only`.
jess: I'll add the dashboard card: v1/v2 counts, mismatch_ratio, p50/p95 latency delta.
inga: (typo) — inga not relevant
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write job will start 2024-05-03T02:00Z if feature flags enabled :gear:
anya: Thanks. I'll draft the runbook PR and assign owners: Jess UI, Eva telemetry, Mike projection/index, Rohan rollout. Planning to enable dual-write Tue AM unless objections.
mike: I'll add index DDL to the PR.
eva: Pushing metric and sampling config today.
rohan: I'll implement p95 auto-abort in rollout controller and add a safepoint export step for routing metadata before cutover.
anya: Closing thread, follow-up in PR.
